prompt: Seamless tileable texture of uncoated printed poster stock, the paper a festival timetable is screen-printed on. Warm off-white (#f2ede4), extremely subtle: fine paper fibre, faint tooth, a few tiny pale flecks, no folds, no stains, no vignette, no ink, no text. Even lighting, flat, edge-to-edge, must tile without visible seams. Low contrast so dark text stays perfectly readable on top.
